scripts.build:netlify: next build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');function c(s,d){fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync(s)){const sp=p.join(s,f),dp=p.join(d,f);fs.statSync(sp).isDirectory()?c(sp,dp):fs.copyFileSync(sp,dp)}}if(fs.existsSync('netlify-upload-ready'))fs.rmSync('netlify-upload-ready',{recursive:true});c('out','netlify-upload-ready');console.log('netlify-upload-ready folder is ready to upload!')"
scripts.build:github-pages: set GITHUB_PAGES=true&& set NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH=/CSC&& set NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://naincsc.in&& next build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');function c(s,d){fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync(s)){const sp=p.join(s,f),dp=p.join(d,f);fs.statSync(sp).isDirectory()?c(sp,dp):fs.copyFileSync(sp,dp)}}if(fs.existsSync('github-pages-ready'))fs.rmSync('github-pages-ready',{recursive:true});c('out','github-pages-ready');console.log('github-pages-ready folder is ready to upload!')"
scripts.preview: npm run build && npm run start
